name: tripwise
description: TripWise: run the website and the API together from here (see README > Getting started)

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --mode real"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
